identity.summary: Two-stage RISC-V 64-bit semantics purification bridging LeanRV64D's monadic Sail executors (SailM ExecutionResult) via monadic skeletons (RISCV/Skeleton.lean) and intermediate pure functions (RISCV/SailPure.lean, RISCV/SailToRV64.lean, 61 theorems) to a pure BitVec 64 instruction dialect (RISCV/Instructions.lean, RISCV/SailPureToInstructions.lean, 87 operations, 69 theorems).

MLIR SSA dialect framework embedding opencompl/riscv-lean as RISCV64.RV64 (SSA/Projects/RISCV64/Base.lean) and coupling it to LLVM IR via the hybrid dialect LLVMPlusRiscV (SSA/Projects/LLVMRiscV/LLVMAndRiscv.lean) and peephole refinement rewrites (SSA/Projects/LLVMRiscV/PeepholeRefine.lean).

End-to-end verified RISC-V 64-bit ELF interpreter and compiler over the Sail RV64 model (Lean_RV64D_executable) proved using only standard Lean axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) via #simp_nf decodeN, TextPiece byte pinning, RetireReads/stepObs_exec, reflective SWP symbolic execution, and Iris adequacy.

Sail-generated Lean 4 RV64D specification (Lean_RV64D) pinned by opencompl/riscv-lean's lake-manifest.json and vendored in executable form (Lean_RV64D_executable) by BasisResearch/ship-your-interpreter.
Lean 4 support library for Sail-generated monadic specifications (PreSail, EStateM, SequentialState, IntRange.forIn') pinned by opencompl/riscv-lean.

Anneal's trusted verification boundary (trusted/lean/Trusted/Refinement.lean, StepResult.lean, MirSemantics.lean) and TCB auditor (trusted/audit/TrustedBoundary.lean, trusted/lean/foundation-lock.json).
Lean 4 theorem prover (commit 5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) used to verify support/two_tier_isa_dialect_and_elf_refinement_probe.lean under -j1 -M768.
